$comment: Stratlas build of COLMAP 4.2.1 (M10 G1). Replaces COLMAP's own vcpkg.json at build time. Differences from upstream: ceres without suitesparse and lapack (GPL CHOLMOD and SPQR, libgfortran), no gui, download, cuda, onnx or cgal features (Qt, curl, OpenSSL, SiftGPU, CGAL), openimageio with no optional features (no libraw, libheif, ffmpeg, opencv), minizip-ng (under OpenColorIO) with zlib only (no OpenSSL). faiss (fetched by COLMAP) needs BLAS and LAPACK: on Windows the static triplet makes vcpkg's lapack choose CLAPACK (f2c, no gfortran) over OpenBLAS; macOS uses Accelerate. The licence gate (tools/release/native-licences.mjs) checks the resulting SBOMs.
name: stratlas-colmap
